about.title: About Me
bio: I create modern and intuitive digital experiences, combining web design and frontend development for projects that not only look great but are also delightful to use. At the same time, I enjoy bringing visual identities to life through logos, catalogs, and other branding or print assets, so each project communicates clearly and consistently across every format.

testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.subtitle: What clients say about working with me

items.name: Bogdan Danaila
items.text: Beyond enthusiasm and a strong focus on quality, he has a client-oriented vision and consistently brings ideas and proposals, offering highly effective and constructive web and graphic design consultancy.

items.name: Michael Dan Popa
items.text: Message strategy, design, implementation, and optimization consultancy are all aimed at retention and visitor loyalty goals, not just at delivering a product as quickly as possible.

items.name: Catalin Bozienita
items.text: We were highly impressed by Bogdan's ability to deliver a corporate identity that perfectly symbolizes our vision and conveys a stylish, elegant, and modern image. We confidently recommend him.

items.name: Iosif Cristian Dietter
items.text: We are very satisfied with our new brand identity and with the way Bogdan approaches his work. It was a great experience and a pleasure to collaborate with him.

items.name: Adrian Stefanescu
items.text: A talented designer with an excellent ability to turn our vision into a fresh, elegant, and well-structured presentation. He quickly understood our needs and delivered creative solutions with great attention to detail. I highly recommend him.

items.name: Laurentiu Bozienita
items.text: Bogdan supported us with both design and website development, and the result came out exactly as we wanted: modern, fast, and easy to use. I recommend him to anyone who wants a well-crafted website, from concept to implementation.
